detail.title: Obstacles to Ethical Decision-Making and Obedience Limits
detail.summary: Revised notebook exploring how mental models, institutional obedience pressures, and systemic constraints hinder independent ethical reasoning and create vulnerabilities in intelligent decision-making.
detail.reason: Revising the project notebook to incorporate new evidence on social choice and aggregation frameworks alongside existing obedience literature.

detail.title: Criteria for Research Question Abandonment
detail.summary: This notebook establishes that research question abandonment, when viewed through the lens of resource-constrained metareasoning, is an optimal epistemic strategy for preserving agent performance in non-stationary environments.
detail.reason: The project is synthesis-ready and addresses the core inquiry on abandonment thresholds using established metareasoning evidence.
